Application ref: P2024/1941/FUL & P2024/1942/LBC
description: The restoration and refurbishment of the Sunday School at the Union Chapel. To provide a flexible space for community use and preserve and create a publicly accessible home for the Chapel's fascinating 200-year-old un-catalogued Collection. The proposals include: alterations to previously approved secondary balustrade at gallery level; and access hatch to roof void (Application ref: P2024/1941/FUL & P2024/1942/LBC). Minor layout alteration to previously approved infilling of unusable lightwell to create room (Application ref: P2024/1941/FUL & P2024/1942/LBC). New works proposed to level existing concrete floor slab in entrance lobby. New fire rated wall and door proposed within ground floor store room.
decision_conditions:
3 YEAR CONSENT PERIOD FOR LBC and CAC: The works hereby permitted shall be begun not later than three years from the date of this consent.

REASON: To comply with the provisions of Section 18(1)(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).
